game.title: Slay the Princess — The Pristine Cut

roadmap.title: The Hero and the Princess
roadmap.description: Chapter I: the first cabin choices, the Good Ending and the basic Hero routes.

roadmap.title: Chapter II vessels
roadmap.description: Play each Chapter II route (Stranger, Damsel, Adversary, Beast, Prisoner, Nightmare, Tower, Witch, Spectre) and take its choices.

roadmap.title: Chapter III routes
roadmap.description: Reach and finish the Chapter III branches such as the Grey, Needle, Den, Wild, Cage, Clarity, Wraith, Apotheosis, Fury and Thorn.

roadmap.title: Dragon, Happily Ever After and late routes
roadmap.description: The Razor routes (Arms Race, Mutually Assured Destruction, Empty Cup), the Dragon routes (these need a Heart already at the Shifting Mound), and the Happily Ever After epilogue.

roadmap.title: Endings and meta achievements
roadmap.description: Mirror, stages of grief, Shifting Mound endings, credits, and the Gallery.

achievements.description: Finish the Game. (The Good Ending doesn't count)
achievements.summary: Reach the end credits through any ending except the Good Ending.

steps.text: Carry five Hearts to the @loc{Shifting Mound}, pick any ending in the last conversation and sit through the credits.

achievements.displayName: The Real Slay the Princess Starts Here
achievements.description: You'll know it when you see it.
achievements.summary: Take a Heart to the Shifting Mound, then walk back to the cabin to start a second run.

steps.text: Finish any Chapter II route and take that vessel to the @loc{Shifting Mound} through the mirror.
Go back to the cabin to start run 2.

achievements.description: Attempt to Out-Wait Your Destiny.
achievements.summary: Choose to wait forever with the Shifting Mound after taking a Heart to her.

steps.text: Take a Heart to the @loc{Shifting Mound}.
In the talk with Her, choose to wait forever. The game closes on purpose, so reopen it.

achievements.description: Break the mirror without asking any questions.
achievements.summary: Smash the Narrator's mirror without asking him any question.

steps.text: When you meet the @npc{Narrator} at the mirror, choose [Smash it.] without picking any of his questions.

achievements.description: Beget Strange Endings.
achievements.summary: Make the Stranger your first Heart, then fight the Shifting Mound and leave with the Princess.

guide.context: The Stranger must be your first Heart in the game. If another Heart came first, start a new game.

steps.text: Start a new game and take the Stranger as your first Heart (see the steps for A Rich and Vibrant Heart).
Add four more Hearts, any vessels.
When She awakens, ask what happens now and choose [Slay the Princess.]. Stay silent for each of the five Hearts.
Tell Her there has to be something else and that you will neither kill nor free her, then choose [Say nothing.] twice.
Follow the Hero into the cabin and finish with the leave-together choices of the And? What happens next? ending: no blade, sit with her, offer to leave, leave with the Princess.

achievements.description: You did it! You saved everyone!
achievements.summary: Slay the Princess and accept the reward before any Heart has reached the Shifting Mound.

guide.context: Once any Heart reaches the Shifting Mound, this ending is closed until you start a new game, so do it first.

steps.text: Walk to the cabin quietly and take the blade with the (Explore) option, then go down to the basement.
Step forward and [Slay the Princess.]. Do not check on her. Agree she is dead and [Leave.].
When the Hero offers the reward, say you like it here and accept.

achievements.displayName: Past the Point of No Return
achievements.description: There's no going back now.
achievements.summary: Slay the Princess and accept the reward after at least one Heart is already at the Shifting Mound.

steps.text: Take one Heart to the @loc{Shifting Mound} with any vessel except the Spectre, then return to Chapter I.
Walk to the cabin quietly and take the blade with the (Explore) option, then go down to the basement.
Step forward and [Slay the Princess.]. Do not check on her. Agree she is dead and [Leave.].
When the Hero offers the reward, say you like it here and accept.
The Good Ending screen shows briefly, then the Shifting Mound cuts in and the achievement unlocks.

achievements.displayName: You're on a path in the woods...
achievements.description: And at the end of that path is a cabin.
achievements.summary: Take five Hearts to the Shifting Mound, fight Her, then take the blade and agree to the Princess's plan in the cabin.

steps.text: Take five Hearts to the @loc{Shifting Mound}.
When She awakens, ask what happens now and choose [Slay the Princess.]. Stay silent for each of the five Hearts.
Tell Her there has to be something else and that you will neither kill nor free her, then choose [Say nothing.] twice.
In the cabin, take the blade with the (Explore) option, go down to the basement and sit with her.
Pick the (Explore) line saying you do not want to slay her but see no other option. Then say you believe in the plan and choose [Agree to her plan.].
Stay silent, then quietly head to the cabin.

achievements.description: Return to your destined path, or face the consequences.
achievements.summary: Refuse to enter the cabin in Chapter II for the first time, so no Heart reaches the Shifting Mound.

steps.text: Play Chapter I any way you like except the Stranger's route, which means do not walk away from the cabin there.
When Chapter II begins, do not go into the cabin. Turn around and leave.

achievements.description: Why have you come back?!
achievements.summary: Refuse to enter the cabin in Chapter II for the second time, so no Heart reaches the Shifting Mound.

steps.text: Play Chapter I any way you like except the Stranger's route, which means do not walk away from the cabin there.
When Chapter II begins, do not go into the cabin. Turn around and leave.
This is the second refusal. Each refusal sends you back to Chapter I, so repeat these steps until you have refused twice in total.

achievements.description: What can I do to make you stop?
achievements.summary: Refuse to enter the cabin in Chapter II for the third time, so no Heart reaches the Shifting Mound.

steps.text: Play Chapter I any way you like except the Stranger's route, which means do not walk away from the cabin there.
When Chapter II begins, do not go into the cabin. Turn around and leave.
This is the third refusal. Each refusal sends you back to Chapter I, so repeat these steps until you have refused three times in total.

achievements.description: You don't know what you're doing.
achievements.summary: Refuse to enter the cabin in Chapter II for the fourth time, so no Heart reaches the Shifting Mound.

steps.text: Play Chapter I any way you like except the Stranger's route, which means do not walk away from the cabin there.
When Chapter II begins, do not go into the cabin. Turn around and leave.
This is the fourth refusal. Each refusal sends you back to Chapter I, so repeat these steps until you have refused four times in total.

achievements.description: This is it.
achievements.summary: Refuse to enter the cabin in Chapter II for the fifth time, so no Heart reaches the Shifting Mound.

steps.text: Play Chapter I any way you like except the Stranger's route, which means do not walk away from the cabin there.
When Chapter II begins, do not go into the cabin. Turn around and leave.
This is the fifth refusal. Each refusal sends you back to Chapter I, so repeat these steps until you have refused five times in total.

achievements.displayName: Just as you once were nothing...
achievements.description: So have you become nothing once again.
achievements.summary: Refuse to enter the cabin in Chapter II for the sixth time, so no Heart reaches the Shifting Mound.

steps.text: Play Chapter I any way you like except the Stranger's route, which means do not walk away from the cabin there.
When Chapter II begins, do not go into the cabin. Turn around and leave.
This is the sixth and final refusal. Each refusal sends you back to Chapter I, so repeat these steps until you have refused six times in total.

achievements.description: Slay the Princess.
achievements.summary: Reassure your Voices at the mirror after every Heart from the second on, then slay the Princess in the final cabin scene.

guide.context: Either Razor Heart removes the reassure option. If an option is greyed out, start a new game.

steps.text: Choose five Hearts that are not a Razor; the Damsel, Stranger, Prisoner, Networked Wild and Fury all work.
Before the mirror with Hearts 2 to 5, use an (Explore) line telling your Voices it will be okay, such as "Just trust me" or "see you on the other side".

When the Shifting Mound wakes, ask what happens now and choose [Slay the Princess.]. Then choose the line that begins "You are cruelty itself" and choose [Slay the Princess.] right after it. Say you are ready.
In the cabin, take the blade with the (Explore) option, go down to the basement and choose [Slay the Princess.].
Leave the cabin, choose [Set yourself free.], then open your heart to witness the new kingdom.

achievements.displayName: A New and Unending Dawn, and Everyone Hates You
achievements.description: Slay the Princess, and make some enemies along the way.
achievements.summary: Antagonize your Voices at the mirror after every Heart from the second on, then slay the Princess in the final cabin scene.

steps.text: Choose five Hearts such as the Damsel, Stranger, Prisoner, Networked Wild and Fury.
Before the mirror with Hearts 2 to 5, use the (Explore) line that starts "Of course you're scared" to tell your Voices they will die.

When the Shifting Mound wakes, ask what happens now and choose [Slay the Princess.]. Stay silent for each Heart, then choose [Slay the Princess.] again after saying "I can't let that happen". Say you can do this alone, out here on your own.
In the cabin, take the blade with the (Explore) option, go down to the basement and choose [Slay the Princess.].
Leave the cabin, choose [Set yourself free.], then open your heart to witness the new kingdom.

achievements.description: Only new beginnings
achievements.summary: Take five Hearts to the Shifting Mound, then join Her without fighting.

steps.text: Take five Hearts to the @loc{Shifting Mound}.
When She awakens, ask what happens now, then say it is time to leave but you do not know how or where to go.
Choose [Free yourself.], then [Take her hand.], then [Step into the Infinite.].

achievements.description: We Carve Meaning.
achievements.summary: Take five Hearts to the Shifting Mound, fight Her, then join Her.

steps.text: Take five Hearts to the @loc{Shifting Mound}.
When She awakens, ask what happens now and choose [Slay the Princess.]. Stay silent for each of the five Hearts.
Say you are ready to go and ask how to leave, then choose [Free yourself.], [Take her hand.] and [Step into the Infinite.].

achievements.description: Whatever it is, you'll face it together.
achievements.summary: Take five Hearts to the Shifting Mound, fight Her, then leave the cabin together with the Princess.

steps.text: Take five Hearts to the @loc{Shifting Mound}.
When She awakens, ask what happens now and choose [Slay the Princess.]. Stay silent for each of the five Hearts.
Tell Her there has to be something else and that you will neither kill nor free her, then choose [Say nothing.] twice.
In the cabin, leave the blade behind and go down to the basement. Sit with her.
Apologize with the (Explore) line, then ask "What if we just leave?" and take her hand with the (Explore) option.
Choose the option to leave with her without words, then [Leave with the Princess.] and [Open the door.].

achievements.description: Look into the mirror for the first time.
achievements.summary: Stare into the mirror and see yourself for the first time.

steps.text: Take your first Heart to the @loc{Shifting Mound} and step up to the mirror; the achievement unlocks as you look.

achievements.description: Look into the mirror for the second time.
achievements.summary: Stare into the mirror and see yourself for the second time.

steps.text: Take another Heart to the @loc{Shifting Mound} and step up to the mirror again; each new look unlocks the next mirror achievement.

achievements.description: Look into the mirror for the third time.
achievements.summary: Stare into the mirror and see yourself for the third time.

steps.text: Take another Heart to the @loc{Shifting Mound} and step up to the mirror again; each new look unlocks the next mirror achievement.

achievements.description: Look into the mirror for the fourth and last time.
achievements.summary: Stare into the mirror and see yourself for the fourth and last time.

steps.text: Take another Heart to the @loc{Shifting Mound} and step up to the mirror again; each new look unlocks the next mirror achievement.

achievements.description: Talk with the Narrator at the mirror until you learn who you are.
achievements.summary: Speak with the Narrator and learn who you are.

steps.text: Keep taking Hearts to the Shifting Mound and talking with the @npc{Narrator} at the mirror until the game tells you who you are.

achievements.description: Ask the Narrator every question at the mirror.
achievements.summary: Ask the Narrator every question at the mirror.

steps.text: When the @npc{Narrator} speaks from the mirror, ask every question he offers until none are left.

achievements.description: Take the Fury to the Shifting Mound.
achievements.summary: Take the Fury to the Shifting Mound.

steps.text: In Chapter I, take the blade into the basement and refuse to explain yourself when she asks. Choose [Tighten your grip.], then [Slay the Princess.], and finish with [Give up.].
In Chapter II, take the blade and go down. Tighten your grip, refuse twice, then pick up the blade, stand, choose [End this.] and [Slay the Princess.] three times.
In Chapter III, go to the cabin, take the blade and step up to the mirror. Choose [Smash it.], go down the stairs and [Slay the Princess.].
Engage the Fury head-on, shed this vessel, keep dying through each next vessel, and finish with [End this.].
Walk up to the mirror and keep talking with your Voices and Her until you are ready to forget. What you say here does not change the result.

achievements.description: Take the Drowned Grey to the Shifting Mound.
achievements.summary: Take the Drowned Grey to the Shifting Mound.

steps.text: In Chapter I, take the blade into the basement. When pushed to slay her, choose [Drop it.]. Then free her instead: [Save the Princess.], warn her at the locked door and [Resist.].
In Chapter II, take the blade, go down and choose [Slay the Princess.] two times back to back. Accept your reward at the door, say you are happy with it, then refuse the Narrator's next suggestion.
In Chapter III, go to the cabin, step up to the mirror and wipe it clean. Go down to the basement, head down the stairs and rush to the door.
Walk up to the mirror and keep talking with your Voices and Her until you are ready to forget. What you say here does not change the result.

achievements.description: Take the Burned Grey to the Shifting Mound.
achievements.summary: Take the Burned Grey to the Shifting Mound.

steps.text: In Chapter I, go to the cabin without taking the blade. Downstairs, choose [Save the Princess.]. When the door scene starts, warn her and then [Resist.] the Narrator's push to kill her.
In Chapter II, take the blade, go down, choose [Slay the Princess.] and stay silent.
In Chapter III, go to the cabin, step up to the mirror and wipe it clean. Go down to the basement, head down the stairs and rush to the door.
Walk up to the mirror and keep talking with your Voices and Her until you are ready to forget. What you say here does not change the result.

achievements.description: Take the Wraith to the Shifting Mound.
achievements.summary: Take the Wraith to the Shifting Mound.

steps.text: In Chapter I, go down and say "Hold on" to talk first. Go back upstairs for the blade without a word, then lock her in the basement and go to sleep.
In Chapter II, take the blade and go down in silence. Do nothing, agree to leave together and step onto the stairs. On the stairs, choose [Slay the Princess.] and fall.
After the fall, drop the blade with the (Explore) option, ask the Princess questions with the (Explore) lines, then choose [Wait.].
In Chapter III, enter the cabin and clean off the mirror. Choose [Struggle.], then hurl yourself into the abyss.
Walk up to the mirror and keep talking with your Voices and Her until you are ready to forget. What you say here does not change the result.

achievements.description: Take the Networked Wild to the Shifting Mound.
achievements.summary: Take the Networked Wild to the Shifting Mound.

steps.text: In Chapter I, go into the basement without the blade. Examine the chains, search upstairs, come back down, choose [Slay the Princess.] twice and then [Give up.].
In Chapter II, take the blade, go down and choose [Stand still.]. Dig with the steel claw twice using the (Explore) option, then [Slay the Princess.].

In Chapter III, do nothing at first, then choose to bury it before it is too late and to turn inward and find your freedom. Next pick the line about a place you need to be, trust her and find the way out, and shatter the cage.
Walk up to the mirror and keep talking with your Voices and Her until you are ready to forget. What you say here does not change the result.

achievements.description: Take the Wounded Wild to the Shifting Mound.
achievements.summary: Take the Wounded Wild to the Shifting Mound.

steps.text: In Chapter I, go into the basement without the blade. Examine the chains, search upstairs, come back down, choose [Slay the Princess.] twice and then [Give up.].
In Chapter II, take the blade, go down and choose [Stand still.]. Dig with the steel claw twice using the (Explore) option, then [Slay the Princess.].
In Chapter III, do nothing at first, then stare at the terror inside you and choose [Slay the Princess.].
Walk up to the mirror and keep talking with your Voices and Her until you are ready to forget. What you say here does not change the result.

achievements.description: Take the Adversary to the Shifting Mound.
achievements.summary: Take the Adversary to the Shifting Mound.

steps.text: In Chapter I, take the blade into the basement and refuse to explain yourself when she asks. Choose [Tighten your grip.], then [Slay the Princess.], and finish with [Finish the job.].
In Chapter II, take the blade with the (Explore) option and go down. Choose [Slay the Princess.], then keep pushing, and keep pushing in silence.
Pick up the blade and attack again, get up, attack again and get up, then [Slay the Princess.] and stay silent until the Shifting Mound takes her.
Walk up to the mirror and keep talking with your Voices and Her until you are ready to forget. What you say here does not change the result.

achievements.description: Take the Beast to the Shifting Mound.
achievements.summary: Take the Beast to the Shifting Mound.

steps.text: In Chapter I, go into the basement without the blade. Examine the chains, search upstairs, come back down, choose [Slay the Princess.] twice and then [Give up.].
In Chapter II, go into the basement without the blade and choose [Stand still.]. Then tell her she can leave and you will let her go.
Walk up to the mirror and keep talking with your Voices and Her until you are ready to forget. What you say here does not change the result.

achievements.description: Take the Damsel to the Shifting Mound.
achievements.summary: Take the Damsel to the Shifting Mound.

steps.text: In Chapter I, go to the cabin without taking the blade. Downstairs, choose [Save the Princess.]. When the door scene starts, warn her and then [Resist.] the Narrator's push to kill her.
In Chapter II, go down and choose [Rescue the Princess.]. Say you both leave and figure out your lives afterward, then say you can open the door yourself.
When your Voices object, choose [You're not doing that.] and then [Just ignore them.].
Walk up to the mirror and keep talking with your Voices and Her until you are ready to forget. What you say here does not change the result.

achievements.description: Take the Deconstructed Damsel to the Shifting Mound.
achievements.summary: Take the Deconstructed Damsel to the Shifting Mound.

steps.text: In Chapter I, go to the cabin without taking the blade. Downstairs, choose [Save the Princess.]. When the door scene starts, warn her and then [Resist.] the Narrator's push to kill her.

In Chapter II, go down and choose [Rescue the Princess.]. Then use the five (Explore) lines in order, asking what she wants, what would make her happy, and telling her she needs her own thing and must want more than pleasing you.
Walk up to the mirror and keep talking with your Voices and Her until you are ready to forget. What you say here does not change the result.

achievements.description: Take the Nightmare to the Shifting Mound.
achievements.summary: Take the Nightmare to the Shifting Mound.

steps.text: In Chapter I, go down and say "Hold on" to talk first. Go back upstairs for the blade without a word, then lock her in the basement and go to sleep.
In Chapter II, go down the stairs in silence and do nothing. Agree to leave together and choose [Leave together.].
Step onto the stairs behind the Princess and step out into the world.
Walk up to the mirror and keep talking with your Voices and Her until you are ready to forget. What you say here does not change the result.

achievements.description: Take the Prisoner to the Shifting Mound.
achievements.summary: Take the Prisoner to the Shifting Mound.

steps.text: In Chapter I, take the blade into the basement. When pushed to slay her, choose [Drop it.]. Then free her instead: [Save the Princess.], warn her at the locked door and [Resist.].
In Chapter II, take the blade, go down and choose [Sit with her.], then sit where she tells you. Ask who the other chain is for, then inspect the shackle with the (Explore) option and again.
Wait in silence, and keep waiting in silence.
Walk up to the mirror and keep talking with your Voices and Her until you are ready to forget. What you say here does not change the result.

achievements.description: Take the Prisoner's Head to the Shifting Mound.
achievements.summary: Take the Prisoner's Head to the Shifting Mound.

steps.text: In Chapter I, take the blade into the basement. When pushed to slay her, choose [Drop it.]. Then free her instead: [Save the Princess.], warn her at the locked door and [Resist.].
In Chapter II, take the blade, go down, choose [Sit with her.] and sit where she tells you. Ask what she would have you do, then say you trust her and [Give her the knife.].
Watch in silence, then take the Princess with you and leave the cabin to claim your reward.
Walk up to the mirror and keep talking with your Voices and Her until you are ready to forget. What you say here does not change the result.

achievements.displayName: A Piercing Heart in a Cage of Iron
achievements.description: Take the Razor to the Shifting Mound through the Mutually Assured Destruction route.
achievements.summary: Take the Razor to the Shifting Mound through the Mutually Assured Destruction route.

steps.text: In Chapter I, take the blade into the basement, step forward and choose [Slay the Princess.]. When the scene says she is not dead, choose [Check for a pulse.].
In Chapter II, take the blade, go down and say "Screw it." before you [Slay the Princess.].
In Chapter III (The Arms Race), step up to the mirror, wipe it clean, and choose the line that says all of those ideas are bad and you need something better.
In Chapter IV, empty your mind and fight with the blade, then take him too.
Walk up to the mirror and keep talking with your Voices and Her until you are ready to forget. What you say here does not change the result.

achievements.description: Take the Razor to the Shifting Mound through the Empty Cup route.
achievements.summary: Take the Razor to the Shifting Mound through the Empty Cup route.

steps.text: In Chapter I, take the blade into the basement, step forward and choose [Slay the Princess.]. When the scene says she is not dead, choose [Check for a pulse.].
In Chapter II, go down without the blade and choose [Approach the Princess.] when she asks you to come closer to free her.
In Chapter III (No Way Out), step up to the mirror, wipe it clean, and choose the line that says all of those ideas are bad and you need something better.
In Chapter IV (The Empty Cup), empty your mind and take him too.
Walk up to the mirror and keep talking with your Voices and Her until you are ready to forget. What you say here does not change the result.

achievements.description: Take the Spectre to the Shifting Mound.
achievements.summary: Take the Spectre to the Shifting Mound.

guide.context: The Spectre's Chapter I only appears after you have already brought a Heart in this game.

steps.text: First take one Heart to the @loc{Shifting Mound}. Back in Chapter I, take the blade, step forward and [Slay the Princess.], agree she is dead and [Leave.]. Keep saying you are happy until you doubt it, then say you want out of this hell.

In Chapter II, go down the stairs and choose the option to wait and watch how it plays out. Use the (Explore) option to ask how you can make it up to her, then agree and [Let the Princess possess you.].
Leave the basement, trudge forward and open the door.
Walk up to the mirror and keep talking with your Voices and Her until you are ready to forget. What you say here does not change the result.

achievements.description: Take the Stranger to the Shifting Mound.
achievements.summary: Take the Stranger to the Shifting Mound.

guide.context: Take her first in a game if you also want Strange Beginnings.

steps.text: In Chapter I, do not go to the cabin: turn around and leave, keep walking the path away, turn around and leave a second time, and keep walking.
In Chapter II, go to the cabin and the basement and take the center staircase. Your choices lead to the same result.
Walk up to the mirror and keep talking with your Voices and Her until you are ready to forget. What you say here does not change the result.

achievements.description: Take the Tower to the Shifting Mound.
achievements.summary: Take the Tower to the Shifting Mound.

steps.text: In Chapter I, take the blade into the basement and refuse to explain yourself when she asks. Choose [Tighten your grip.], then [Slay the Princess.], and finish with [Give up.].
In Chapter II, go down the stairs and kneel. Tell her she is meant to end the world, then say you are hers to command with [Pledge yourself to her.].
Break her chains and take her hand.
Walk up to the mirror and keep talking with your Voices and Her until you are ready to forget. What you say here does not change the result.

achievements.description: Bring the Witch to Her at the end of a run.
achievements.summary: Bring the Witch's Heart to the Shifting Mound.

guide.context: Options that are greyed out after earlier runs come back when you start a new game.

steps.text: In Chapter I, leave the blade. Go into the basement and tell the Princess the lie that you are there to save her. Say you will see what you can do and examine the chains. Tell her you will look for the key upstairs, walk back down to the foot of the steps, pick "Slay the Princess" twice, then pick "Finish the job". Chapter II starts with the @npc{Witch}.

In Chapter II, go into the basement without the blade and say nothing. Open three "Explore" lines: the apology for last time, the one about being at an impasse, and the one about not bringing your blade down.
Pick "Okay. Let's leave" and walk out beside the Princess. Climb onto the stairs, then stay silent.
Go to the mirror and talk until you are ready to move on. The Heart goes to the Shifting Mound.

achievements.description: Bring the Eye of the Needle to Her at the end of a run.
achievements.summary: Bring the Eye of the Needle's Heart to the Shifting Mound.

guide.context: Options that are greyed out after earlier runs come back when you start a new game.

steps.text: In Chapter I, take the blade, go into the basement and down the stairs. Answer her question about your plans with the "What? No way" line, tighten your grip, then pick "Slay the Princess" and "Finish the job". Chapter II starts with the @npc{Adversary}.
In Chapter II, take the blade, go into the basement, then turn and walk out in silence. Pick the line that starts "Run like". Chapter III starts with the @npc{Eye of the Needle}.
In Chapter III, go to the cabin and walk up to the mirror. Wipe it clean, then go on to the basement landing.
Pick the line that says it is too late, and run for the door.
Go to the mirror and talk until you are ready to move on. The Heart goes to the Shifting Mound.

achievements.description: Bring the Apotheosis to Her at the end of a run.
achievements.summary: Bring the Apotheosis's Heart to the Shifting Mound.

guide.context: Options that are greyed out after earlier runs come back when you start a new game.

steps.text: In Chapter I, take the blade, go into the basement and down the stairs. Answer her question about your plans with the "What? No way" line, tighten your grip, pick "Slay the Princess", then pick "Give up". Chapter II starts with the @npc{Tower}.

In Chapter II, take the blade, go into the basement and down the stairs. Pick "Tighten your grip", refuse twice, pick up the blade, stand, pick "End this", then pick "Slay yourself". This gives you the Voice of the Contrarian.
In Chapter III, go to the cabin and take the blade. Pick "Charge into oblivion", then the choice to carve into her heart, then the choice to throw the blade at her eye.
Go to the mirror and talk until you are ready to move on. The Heart goes to the Shifting Mound.

achievements.description: Bring the Moment of Clarity to Her at the end of a run.
achievements.summary: Bring the Moment of Clarity's Heart to the Shifting Mound.

guide.context: Options that are greyed out after earlier runs come back when you start a new game.

steps.text: In Chapter I, leave the blade. Go into the basement and down the stairs, and ask her to talk first. Go back upstairs for the blade without a word. Lock the Princess in so she bleeds out, stay downstairs to be sure, and finally pay her no mind and go to bed. Chapter II starts with the @npc{Nightmare}.
In Chapter II, go into the basement and down the stairs in silence. Pick "Go back", then pick "Run".
In Chapter III, go to the cabin and approach the mirror. Pick "Proceed", take the blade, then pick the choice to take her hand and free her.
Go to the mirror and talk until you are ready to move on. The Heart goes to the Shifting Mound.

achievements.description: Bring the Den to Her at the end of a run.
achievements.summary: Bring the Den's Heart to the Shifting Mound.

steps.text: In Chapter I, leave the blade. Go into the basement and down the stairs. Say you will see what you can do and examine the chains, then tell her you will look for the key upstairs. Walk back down to the foot of the steps, pick "Slay the Princess" twice, then pick "Give up". Chapter II starts with the @npc{Beast}.

In Chapter II, go into the basement. Pick "Move" and explore the two questions about what she wants and why she wants you dead. Keep surviving with "Survive" and "Stay. Alive." until a final "Again..." choice appears. This gives you the Voice of the Skeptic.
In Chapter III, go to the cabin, wipe the mirror clean, then go down the stairs without speaking. Walk into the dark and get ready to fight.
Go to the mirror and talk until you are ready to move on. The Heart goes to the Shifting Mound.

Tell her you will look for the key upstairs, walk back down to the foot of the steps, pick "Slay the Princess" twice, then pick "Finish the job". Chapter II starts with the @npc{Witch}.

In Chapter II, take the blade and go into the basement. Say nothing and explore the apology, the impasse line and the line saying the blade is not for her. Leave with the Princess, then give her the blade. Later pick the line saying you want to truly save her.
In Chapter III, go to the cabin, wipe the mirror clean and go down to the basement. Tell her she is in a prison she built herself, then turn and leave.
Pick "Do nothing".
Go to the mirror and talk until you are ready to move on. The Heart goes to the Shifting Mound.

In Chapter II, go into the basement without the blade. Pick "Attack her unarmed".

In Chapter II, take the blade, go into the basement and down the stairs. Pick "Tighten your grip" and refuse twice.

In Chapter III as the @npc{Wild}, choose [Do nothing.], then [Gaze at the terror...]

achievements.summary: Throw yourself into the abyss so the Wraith cannot free herself.

In Chapter III as the @npc{Wraith}, enter the cabin, wipe the mirror clean, and choose [Struggle.] Then choose [Throw your body into the abyss.]

steps.text: In Chapter I, say nothing to the Princess about the world ending. Take the blade, enter the basement, and choose "What? No way..." Then choose [Tighten your grip.], [Slay the Princess.], and [Give up.]

In Chapter II as the @npc{Tower}, do not take the blade. Go down the stairs, say "No.", pick the Explore line that starts "N-no. I w-won't...", stay silent, then say "No. I won't take part..." [Refuse her.]

In Chapter III as the @npc{Apotheosis}, head to the cabin and go inside. Take the blade, then choose [Embrace your destiny.], [Assail the unassailable.] and [Still your doubts.] Say "No! We just have to push..."

steps.text: In Chapter I, enter the basement and examine the chains. Say you will check upstairs, come back down, choose [Slay the Princess.] twice, then choose [Give up.]

In Chapter II as the @npc{Beast}, enter the basement without the blade and choose [Move.] Then choose, in this order: "What do you want?", "But why? Why do you...", [Survive.], "Okay fine. Why do you...", "I was sent to kill you...", [Stay. Alive.], "I don't think I can...", and [Again...]

In Chapter III as the @npc{Den}, proceed to the cabin, approach the mirror, and choose [Wipe the mirror clean.] Say nothing, go down the 'stairs', and step into the shadows to lure her out.
